theory: Formal evidence consists of an unchanged frozen statement, a rebuilt Lean proof, and an axiom report read under an explicit policy. Search and lexical scanning provide bounded leads and gates; only kernel checking establishes formal proof.
instead_of: Accepting successful elaboration or a plausible retrieved declaration would confuse compilation, search heuristics, and verification authority.

absorption.rationale: A new retrieval source fits; a genuinely independent sandbox or another proof assistant needs new execution and evidence machinery.

world_mapping.rationale: Frozen claims and dependency reports map precisely to what Lean checks and what a theorem assumes.

abstraction.rationale: One axiom policy serves callers with different admission policies without equating their grades.

justification.rationale: The verifier explains why neither model assertions nor an elaboration exit code can settle a result.

honest_limits.rationale: Retrieval preserves provenance and uncertainty; axiom policy does not turn missing reports into independence.

rehearsals.why: Implement PremiseSource while retaining rank provenance and metering.

rehearsals.requirement: Verify in an independently confined process image
rehearsals.why: Fresh reconstruction exists, but process confinement and a separate trusted environment require an additional authority boundary.

rehearsals.requirement: Allow an explicitly declared mathematical assumption
rehearsals.why: Axiom classification already separates sanctioned assumptions from holes and unapproved axioms.
